# appdynamics_role (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics RBAC role by ID, including its permissions. Use the appdynamics_roles data source to discover role_id values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_role" "read_only" {
  role_id = 2695
}

output "read_only_permissions" {
  value = data.appdynamics_role.read_only.permissions_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number) ID of the role to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `permissions_json` (String)
